integrity: Proof includes an exhaustive, reproducible finite graph-clique and ideal-residue certificate. Self-review is not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: This proves the first failure at degree five but makes no claim for degree six and above. Exhaustive enumeration applies to the proved finite 24-neighbor reduction only. Prior literature supplies the local optimality criterion and the general 7-point upper bound; originality outside inspected material is not independently confirmed.
title: First failure of simultaneous prime-ideal balance in \(\mathbb Z[\omega]\)
